rules.rationale: Base equation for xorAcc when the first zipped input is empty; it defines the accumulator result and adds no independent mathematical fact.
Base equation for xorAcc when the second zipped input is empty; it defines truncation at the shorter input.
Recursive xorAcc equation for equal heads; it defines appending code 48 and structurally recursing on both tails.
Recursive xorAcc equation for unequal heads; it defines appending code 49 and structurally recursing on both tails.
Base equation defining the empty IntSeq as a valid bitString.
Structural recurrence defining bitString by checking that the head is code 48 or 49 and recursing on the tail.
Base equation defining lastX to preserve its prior value when the first zipped input is empty.
Base equation defining lastX to preserve its prior value when only the second zipped input is empty.
Recursive lastX equation defining the latest left-hand loop target and descending through both zipped tails.
Base equation defining lastY to preserve its prior value when the first zipped input is empty.
Base equation defining lastY to preserve its prior value when only the second zipped input is empty.
Recursive lastY equation defining the latest right-hand loop target and descending through both zipped tails.

Its exact normalized statement is LOOP-SPEC.loop-invariant; prove.sh proves that claim with bridge-free verification-base-kompiled before proving the dependent entry claim with verification-kompiled, and check_artifacts.py enforces exact rule/claim correspondence.
